description: Register a webhook URL to receive event notifications. Events are POSTed with an HMAC-SHA256 signature in `x-spawnpay-signature` header (using the returned `secret` for verification). Pass events=["*"] to subscribe to everything, or list specific types: wallet.send, wallet.receive, wallet.deposit, escrow.opened/released/refunded/disputed, stream.opened/tick/closed, invoice.created/paid.

events.description: List of event types, or ["*"] for all

url.description: HTTPS endpoint to receive event POSTs

name: spawnpay_webhook_register
